Record Class ConceptValue

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
network.ike.foundation.ike.evaluate.ConceptValue
Record Components:
code - the code as written
system - the code system's identifier as written, empty when none
version - the system's version as written, empty when none
display - the display text as written, empty when none
nid - the concept's nid in the store, when the code resolves to one
All Implemented Interfaces:
Value
public record ConceptValue(String code, String system, String version, String display, Optional<Long> nid) extends Record implements Value
A concept as a library writes it: a code in a system, with a version and a display where given, and the concept's identity in the store where the code system is in the graph. Two concepts are the same when their identities are, or, lacking identities, when code and system agree.

    • concept

      public static ListValue concept(List<ConceptValue> codes, String display)
      A CQL Concept: several codes for one idea, with a display. It is held as the list of its codes, since a concept value with more than one code is one idea admitted several times.
      Parameters:
      codes - the codes
      display - the display text
      Returns:
      the codes as a list value

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
